Whether it’s a family reunion, corporate retreat, or milestone birthday, Advantage Grand Canyon makes planning effortless: We coordinate all 16 licensed outfitters, secure your launch, and customize your trip from raft type to menu style. services.name: Trail ride
services.desc: Many Grand Canyon rafting trips include a hike along the iconic Bright Angel Trail-either into the canyon to start your journey or out at the end. Advantage Grand Canyon’s experts have done both, and we’ve compiled everything you need to know about this challenging but rewarding hike. From elevation gain and rest stops to water availability and preparation tips, this guide helps you safely navigate one of the most famous trails in the world. If your Grand Canyon rafting trip covers only the Upper Canyon or Lower Canyon, chances are it includes the legendary Bright Angel Trail-one of the most iconic (and demanding) hikes in the world.
